source_context_policy: Task provides target context. Omitted target fields inherit it; explicit conflicts are never repaired. Vendor pc/unknown equivalence is limited to matching architecture, OS, environment and object format. Data layouts must agree on used supported types and AS0 pointer representation.
semantic_policy: Keep instructions, semantic flags, attributes and metadata in the candidate; prove/refute with Alive2 and independently execute. No body optimization or repair before scoring.
feedback_policy: No free-form self-review in primary comparison. A separate preregistered diagnostic-hint condition uses identical semantic counterexamples from authored mutants for both models, only if its pilot is interpretable. It is not repair of model-specific prior outputs.
qwen_system_prompt: Return exactly one complete LLVM IR module enclosed in a single ... block. Do not repeat the original input or include any other code block.
